attributes.name: mode
attributes.digest: Render mode
attributes.description: Five different modes are possible: mode 0 renders points, mode 1 renders lines, mode 2 renders area between the float value and the horizontal axis at 0.0, and mode 3 renders the area in a bipolar way (reflected in the horizontal axis). Unlike the other modes, which all expect one-dimensional matrices, mode 4 expects a two dimensional matrix, with one row of upper and one row of lower values, which it then renders as vertical bars, coloring the space between the lower and upper values.
